name: CodePushUp
description: Run Code PushUp code quality analysis and post results to pull requests
author: Code PushUp

inputs.name: bin
inputs.label: CLI executable
inputs.helpMarkDown: Custom Code PushUp CLI executable path or command

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Config file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a custom Code PushUp config file

inputs.name: directory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Working directory for Code PushUp CLI

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: Azure DevOps Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Token for Azure DevOps API authentication. Defaults to System.AccessToken.

inputs.name: silent
inputs.label: Silent mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Suppress CLI output logs

inputs.name: skipComment
inputs.label: Skip PR comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Skip posting a comment on the pull request

inputs.name: detectNewIssues
inputs.label: Detect new issues
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enable detection of new issues in changed files

inputs.name: debug
inputs.label: Debug mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enable debug logging

inputs.name: monorepo
inputs.label: Enable monorepo mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enable monorepo mode for multi-project analysis

inputs.name: monorepoTool
inputs.label: Monorepo tool
inputs.helpMarkDown: Monorepo tool to use for project discovery

inputs.name: monorepoParallel
inputs.label: Parallel execution
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run monorepo tasks in parallel

inputs.name: monorepoParallelMax
inputs.label: Max parallel tasks
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum number of parallel tasks

inputs.name: monorepoProjects
inputs.label: Project filter
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated list of project folder globs

inputs.name: monorepoTask
inputs.label: Task name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Monorepo task/target name

inputs.name: nxProjectsFilter
inputs.label: Nx projects filter
inputs.helpMarkDown: Arguments for 'nx show projects' command

inputs.name: configPatterns
inputs.label: Config patterns
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pre-defined persist/upload configs as JSON

inputs.name: searchCommits
inputs.label: Search commits for baseline
inputs.helpMarkDown: Search multiple commits for a previous report

inputs.name: searchCommitsMax
inputs.label: Max commits to search
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum number of commits to search for a previous report

inputs.name: customSourceRef
inputs.label: Custom source ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Override the source branch/tag reference

inputs.name: customTargetRef
inputs.label: Custom target ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Override the target branch/tag reference
